name: readability-gate
description: A Stop hook that checks the final message of each turn answers the owner in plain spoken English, using the talk-normal rules: the answer first, no names or numbers the owner has not seen, none of Claude's own process, and every decision explained. A reader model writes the message the owner wanted: the answer to their request and only what they must do or decide now. A message fails when the owner cannot act on it or when that draft is much shorter, and goes back once for Claude to send the draft with its facts checked. The same rules are added to Claude's context at session start. Fails open with a visible warning. Claude Code only. No MCP server, no skills.

hooks.statusMessage: Checking the reply reads without context...
